extracted.intended_audience: researchers, patent historians, librarians, and patent professionals seeking bibliographic/index information on U.S. patents issued in 1878
extracted.subtask_description: An alphabetical index/listing of patentees for the year 1878 showing patent numbers, inventor names/residences, invention titles, issue dates, monthly volume and Official Gazette references. Useful as a bibliographic metadata source for historical patent lookup and citation.
